summary: Exclude only provably unpainted rounded corners; independently owned child paint remains separately measured under unchanged quality gates.
invariants: Supported childless HTML surfaces use CSS-normalized per-corner px/percent radii and a conservative antialias boundary band.
A parent DIV with no owned text may have one leaf DIV child only when both have valid distinct globally unique QIDs.
Surface domains remain owner-local; closest-QID separation preserves child paint/text/transform probes and independent quality gates.
Complex paint or mapping keeps prior rectangle/unknown behavior; excluded points are never counted as visible or known.
The 5 percent unknown limit, nonempty known evidence, actual cover detection, original HTML/PNG and QID geometry remain unchanged.
Occlusion, DOM and measurement cache identities change together; retained evidence is remeasured instead of relabeled.
forbidden: Unknown-to-pass substitution, threshold weakening, exclusion of owned text, or inherited parent clipping domains.
Removing unsupported paint evidence, mutating authored content, or generalizing the single independently owned child boundary.
